items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: I didn't know about those two guys. Yeah. ... I listened to one concert he gave in Paris... I didn't know it when he started it, and I didn't know nothing about it when he finished it.

ctx.x: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

So they asked me, he says, when my job finished, you see, when my job finished, they asked me if I wanted to stay in my room. I said, sure, and that was luck, you know, and I didn't want to go back to the state, you know. That was really jammed up in my king. I said, I jump on it, I said, sure, because he says, you see, we can't have him, Charlie, and so far, because his wife had already sent him a ticket, you know, the money for him to come back to New Orleans, and he took that money and drank it up.
